item.author: SpaceX & International Space Community

item.title: Evidence Found That Red Dwarf Stars Are Swallowing Planets
item.author: Keele University & RAS
item.description: Astronomers have discovered evidence that red dwarf stars are swallowing planets orbiting them, revealed by high levels of lithium.
